lines: Records mono or stereo audio, or the Rack window as video, to a file on disk
Gain applied to the signal before it is written, from silence to +12dB
Click to start recording and click again to stop; if no output file has been chosen a file dialog opens first
Recording runs while the gate here is high and stops when it falls, which gives one file per gate
Each trigger here switches recording on, and the next one switches it off
The left channel of the recording, and the whole of it when RIGHT has no cable
The right channel of the recording; a cable here makes the file stereo instead of mono
Note — the meter shows the level going in, and a red light means the audio is clipping, so lower the gain
Menu — Output file sets the path written to, and can only be changed while recording is stopped
Menu — the audio formats are WAV, AIFF, FLAC, ALAC and MP3, and the video formats MPEG-2, FFV1 and HuffYUV; the format can only be changed while recording is stopped
Menu — Append -001, -002, etc. numbers each new file rather than overwriting the last recording
